result.one_liner: Attio is a modern, flexible, data-driven CRM platform with customizable objects and AI-driven workflows for revenue teams.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to authenticate with Attio: access tokens, or OAuth. Access tokens are scoped to a single workspace, while OAuth is only required if you plan on publishing an integration.
API access requires approval and comes with rate limits, typically around 1,000 calls per hour.
The documentation covers REST endpoints, GraphQL support, webhook configuration, and authentication methods.
REST API exposes core CRM objects through standardized endpoints supporting CRUD operations, including Deals, Companies, People, Users, and Workspaces.
Community-maintained MCP server for Attio enabling agent-driven workflows.

result.notes: API available across all pricing tiers (Free to Enterprise) but requires admin/app approval to enable. Bearer token and OAuth 2.0 supported. Official Attio MCP mentioned in 2026 updates but community implementation available now.
